lead: No exhausting challenges or promises of a perfect body. I share what I've learned about training, nutrition fundamentals, and building habits that last.

title: Not perfection.
Consistency.
approach.sub: Training and nutrition shouldn't become a second job. My goal is to help you understand the basics, find a sustainable rhythm, and stick with it beyond the first two weeks.
cards: Realistic goals, consistency, and working through the obstacles that hold you back.
Understanding general principles of training load, recovery, and tracking progress.
Talking about calories, protein, and eating habits without rigid restrictions or therapeutic diets.

services.title: Simple and affordable.
services.sub: A small fee for my time, attention, and personal experience. No expensive subscriptions or pushy sales.
services.note: This is educational mentoring based on personal experience, not medical care or professional personal training. Plans do not include individualized exercise prescriptions or therapeutic diets.

about.title: Hi, I'm Andrey.
paragraphs: I'm a software developer, and training has become part of my everyday life. I like a systematic approach: observe, measure progress, learn, and gradually improve habits.
I don't claim to be a certified personal trainer or dietitian. I share what I've learned and tried myself, and help others stay consistent.
about.quote: “A good system works even when motivation doesn't.”

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: Yes, if you're looking for general knowledge, support, and help with habits. For personalized exercise technique or training loads, consult a qualified trainer.
Do you create personalized workout plans or diets?
No. We can discuss general principles of training and nutrition, but I don't prescribe individualized training loads, therapeutic diets, or medical advice.

What happens during the first meeting?
You tell me about your goals, we discuss expectations, and decide whether this format would be useful for you.
